quickSummary: Abused drugs: Opioids (Papaver somniferum latex; Morphine & Heroin/diacetylmorphine/smack; binds CNS & GI receptors; depressant), Cannabinoids (Cannabis sativa inflorescences; Marijuana, Hashish, Ganja; binds brain cannabinoid receptors; impairs cardiovascular system), Coca Alkaloids (Erythroxylum coca; Cocaine/coke/crack; blocks dopamine reuptake transporter; potent CNS stimulant, euphoria, hallucinations), and Hallucinogens (LSD from Claviceps purpurea, Datura, Atropa belladonna).

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Abused substances fall into 3 major classes: (1) Opioids from Papaver somniferum (Heroin/Morphine) acting on CNS/GI receptors as depressants; (2) Cannabinoids from Cannabis sativa acting on brain receptors affecting the cardiovascular system; (3) Coca alkaloids from Erythroxylum coca blocking dopamine reuptake as potent CNS stimulants. Hallucinogens (LSD, Datura, Belladonna) alter perception.

conceptBreakdown.content:
### 9.1 Comprehensive Drug Classification

| Drug Class | Natural Source Plant | Receptors & Mode of Action | Key Derivatives / Forms | Primary Physiological Effects |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Opioids** | Opium Poppy (***Papaver somniferum***) | Specific Opioid Receptors in Central Nervous System & Gastrointestinal Tract | **Morphine** (sedative & painkiller); **Heroin** ("Smack" - chemically **Diacetylmorphine**, produced by acetylation of morphine) | Potent **depressant**; slows down body functions; highly addictive |
| **Cannabinoids** | Hemp Plant (***Cannabis sativa***) | Cannabinoid Receptors located predominantly in the **Brain** | Marijuana, Hashish, Charas, Ganja (from inflorescences, leaves, resins) | Alters sensory perception; drastically impairs the **Cardiovascular System** (tachycardia) |
| **Coca Alkaloids** | Coca Shrub (***Erythroxylum coca***, South America) | Specifically **blocks the reuptake transporter of Dopamine** in synaptic clefts | **Cocaine** ("Coke" or "Crack") | Potent **CNS stimulant**; induces intense euphoria, increased alertness; high doses trigger **hallucinations** |
| **Hallucinogens / Psychedelics** | ***Atropa belladonna***, ***Datura stramonium***, and ***Claviceps purpurea*** | Serotonin ($5\text{-HT}$) receptors in brain | **LSD (Lysergic Acid Diethylamide)** derived from ergot fungus (*Claviceps*) | Profound alteration of thoughts, feelings, and perceptions; vivid auditory and visual hallucinations |

conceptBreakdown.heading: Medical Uses of Morphine
conceptBreakdown.title: Medical Uses of Morphine
conceptBreakdown.content: Morphine is a clinically indispensable narcotic analgesic administered post-operatively to relieve severe surgical trauma pain and manage terminal cancer pain under strict medical supervision.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Doping in Sports (Anabolic Steroids)
conceptBreakdown.title: Doping in Sports (Anabolic Steroids)
conceptBreakdown.content: Athletes misuse anabolic steroids, diuretics, and narcotic analgesics to increase muscle mass and aggressive power, leading to severe side-effects including liver dysfunction, infertility, masculinization in females, and testicular atrophy in males.
